bio: Graphic Design graduate from the National Institute of Design, Ahmedabad, associated with the Indian Type Foundry since her college years, helping with retail and custom fonts before joining as a permanent typeface designer in 2014. Designed typefaces including Hind, Begum, Nippo, Begum Sans, Chillax, Sarpanch, Teko, Torrent, and Begum Devanagari.

sources.title: Manushi Parikh — Indian Type Foundry designer profile
